description: Lists aicut's authored image-story STYLES: named looks (a character, a rendering treatment, an art direction) that every scene of the video is drawn in. Free, instant, creates nothing. OPTIONAL, NOT THE DEFAULT: most image stories use aicut's ordinary photorealistic look, which is also the cheapest; call this when the user asks what looks exist or wants a consistent stylised world. IT CHANGES THE PRICE: a style runs only on the edit-capable image model (`requires_image_model` on every entry: `gpt-image-2.5`, five times the cheapest look's per-image price), so after settling on one re-quote with `generate_image_story`'s `estimate_only` before asking to spend. PRESENTING: name at most 3 that fit what the user described, one line each, and SHOW each by putting its `preview_url` in your reply as a markdown image (`![name](preview_url)`) so they pick by eye; never dump the list. An empty list means aicut ships no featured styles right now (normal, not an error): carry on without one. 503 `image_story_styles_unavailable` = the catalog is down: say so and offer to create without a style.
name: list_image_story_styles
title: List the authored looks for AI image story videos
